title: Export with search not holds the same parts as the screen
custom_preconds:
• Untracked parts and tracked parts matching "not" exist.
  • Parts > Inventory, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Search "not" and note the parts listed.
  2. Click ⋮ > Export and open the CSV.
custom_expected:
Step 2:

  • The CSV holds the same parts as the screen (one row per bin, so a part with 2 bins has 2 rows).
  • Untracked parts show Not Tracked in the quantity column.
